The evidence points to a potential regulatory mechanism where Acronyculatin E indirectly affects the phosphatase activity through its interaction with CDK3/cyclin E. The relationship is further supported by the presence of a direct target link between GlyTouCan:G99562EF and Protein-tyrosine phosphatase LC-PTP, indicating a possible downstream effect of Acronyculatin E on this phosphatase. The mechanism is consistent with a role in cellular signaling and regulation, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
